# Arslan Younas

> AI SEO strategist based in Lahore, Pakistan, with 5+ years in SEO. Helps brands rank on Google and get cited in AI answers through technical SEO, entity SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization).

The full portfolio site is in progress. This page is the canonical home for Arslan Younas until it launches.

## Facts
- Current role: Sr. AI SEO Strategist at Cyber Nest (USA), Sales and Marketing, since May 2024
- Previous roles: SEO Analyst at Clicktap – Intelliscence (UAE, 2023 to 2024); SEO Specialist at Tech Nerds (USA, 2021 to 2023); SEO Intern at Ideoversity (Pakistan, 2021)
- Education: BS Computer Science, NCBA&E, Lahore
- Markets: USA, UK, MENA and Europe
- Focus areas: technical SEO, site architecture, structured data, entity SEO, content strategy and topical authority, GEO, AEO, local and international SEO
